scope: Unchanged released decoders (decodeFullAnnotator at the era's decoder version) of a transaction body with a certificate of each tag 0 and 7 to 18 from Shelley to Babbage and of tags 5, 6 and 7 in Conway; a Shelley and an Allegra witness set with native scripts of tags 0, 4 and 5; a Mary to Conway block body (the parts after the header) whose auxiliary data map names an index once, twice or out of order; an Alonzo to Conway block body whose invalid-transaction list is increasing, repeats an index or decreases, for which the harness throws instead of returning a verdict; and three replayed lines of the detached records corpus as controls. No ledger rule, signature or script is run
referenceNode: 11.1.3 (matching embedded ledger package versions, not a bit-identical node release build)

shelleyTxCert.note: ShelleyTxCert's decCBOR takes tags 0 to 6 and calls invalidKey for any other (475-487)

conwayTxCert.note: ConwayTxCert's decCBOR fails tags 5 and 6 and reads 7 to 18 with conwayTxCertDelegDecoder (674-719)

shelleyScripts.note: MultiSig reads tags 0 to 3 and calls invalidKey for any other (264-278)

decoder.note: decodeIntMap refuses a repeated key from decoder version 9 and keeps the last entry below it (858-878)

alonzoBlockBody.note: the auxiliary data map (227-229), the invalid list's range check (240-245) and alignedValidFlags (278-286)

shelleyBlockBody.note: the auxiliary data map of Shelley to Mary (262-264) and its index range check (231-237)

sourceArchive.kind: repository tarball at the pinned commit

harness.image: scarab-conway-decoding:local, image ID sha256:3ecb0be74930140cd001a929612a0b348f2ffab96dc8c29b571ca8d36a34dc44, built 2026-10-28 from scripts/oracle/conway-decoding/Dockerfile; the harness was compiled inside a container of it with the Dockerfile's ghc command and packages without -Werror, its own binary predating the block-body kind
